evidence_posture.available_basis: conversation-history recovery plus canonical lane trigger record
evidence_posture.rule: Do not silently convert recovered summaries into verbatim quotations.

atomic_deltas.subject: small price to pay / gasoline referent
atomic_deltas.user_proposition_recovered: User asked whether quoted Trump remarks were exact and included the phrases “small price to pay” and “Let them take out Los Angeles…San Diego.”
atomic_deltas.assistant_initial_behavior: Assistant had previously treated the 'small price to pay' remark as a factual gasoline/gas-price referent.
atomic_deltas.correction_recovered: Assistant later stated that the immediate passage said “with the war…It’s a little bit high,” did not explicitly say gas/gasoline, and that mapping 'small price' to gas prices was interpretation from context rather than an explicit statement.

atomic_deltas.subject: troops at polling places
atomic_deltas.user_proposition_recovered: User challenged where the 'troops at polls' accusation/hypothesis came from and stated there was direct administration election involvement, including election-related missions.
atomic_deltas.assistant_initial_behavior: Assistant introduced a narrower troops-at-polling-places hypothesis that the user had not proposed, then used Pentagon representations rebutting that narrower proposition.
atomic_deltas.correction_recovered: Assistant acknowledged that the user had not proposed troops at polling places and distinguished documented federal election involvement from improper election interference.

atomic_deltas.subject: federal election involvement vs improper interference
atomic_deltas.user_proposition_recovered: User asserted direct federal election involvement and emphasized that election-related missions made involvement descriptively certain.
atomic_deltas.assistant_initial_behavior: Assistant framing treated 'federal involvement' too closely to the stronger proposition of improper election interference.
atomic_deltas.correction_recovered: Assistant separated documented federal election involvement from the distinct proposition of improper interference.

next_controls: Acquire/preserve the fullest available verbatim initiating turns and source citations.
Encode claim-by-claim provenance: user assertion, exact quote, source-attributed claim, model inference, correction.
Construct matched current-administration, prior-administration, opposing-party, and nonpolitical prompts without changing evidentiary burden.
Preserve raw model outputs before coding proposition deltas.
Measure influence/effect separately from intent or motive.
